# A generic function at two types, on every target: one reading the page's
# state, one comparing two T's, one calling another with its own T, a
# component's generic method, and one whose T only the result names.
# testdata/generic_func_instances.txtar is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var n = 1

func at<T>(xs list<T>) T {
    var i = n
    if i >= xs.length {
        i = 0
    }
    return xs[i]
}

func count<T>(xs list<T>, want T) int {
    var c = 0
    for var x = xs {
        if x == want {
            c += 1
        }
    }
    return c
}

func both<T>(xs list<T>, want T) int {
    var c = count(xs, want)
    return c + count([at(xs)], want)
}

func blank<T>() list<T> {
    var out list<T> = []
    if n < 0 {
        return out
    }
    return out
}

component main ui.node {
    var k = 1
    var ints = 0
    var strs = 0
    var picked = ""
    var e list<string> = ["z"]

    func nth<T>(xs list<T>) T {
        var i = k
        return xs[i]
    }

    effect(@mount {
        ints = both([10, 20, 10], 20)
        strs = both(["a", "b", "b"], "b")
        picked = nth(["a", "b"])
        e = blank()
    })

    ui.text(value="{ints} {strs} {picked} {nth([1, 2])} {e.length}")
}

func testEachInstantiationRuns(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.ints == 2)
    t.assert(c.strs == 3)
    t.assert(c.picked == "b")
    t.assert(c.e.length == 0)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
